description: This is a line plot with two y-axes. The left y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale with a minimum of 1.0 and a maximum of 4.0. The right y-axis, labeled "BLEU scores", has a linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 1.0. There are three lines in the plot. The blue line, labeled "Regular members", starts at a loss of 3.5 and ends at a loss of 3.0. The orange line, labeled "Members with near-duplicates", starts at a loss of 2.5 and ends at a loss of 2.0. The green line, labeled "Held-out data", starts at a loss of 3.5 and ends at a loss of 3.0.
